production.description: Current BiME-Rank runtime behavior; legacy Catalyst/terpene component names are compatibility paths, not separate public methods.

claims.description: Claim-specific primary evidence with hashes; never select by latest glob, version number, or mtime.

database.description: Canonical general candidate universe; benchmark-specific and application-specific supports remain separate scopes.

publication_assets.description: Separates direct Git assets, rebuildable large matrices, external foundation assets, and private/local-only state.

judge_narrative.description: Narrative presentation only; validators lock presented numbers to canonical evidence.

application.description: Predictions and construct/experiment plans; not biochemical activity measurements.

current_canonical.selection: explicit reviewed claim IDs; never latest glob

reproducibility_assets.note: includes the dependency graph, protected-file lock, source-role map and claim-level source provenance; frozen evidence and exact command-level replay are explicitly distinguished

raw_data.policy: Preserve public source tables and immutable evaluation supports. Private/local lab inventory may exist on the server but is outside the Git release and must not be treated as a public reproduction dependency.

rebuildable_cache.policy: derived normalization/concatenation with source manifests, but current E2R experts consume these; retain online. Rebuildable does not mean currently removable

historical_superseded.policy: Historical claim sources are never current authority. Preserve when they support audit/reproducibility; local payloads may be move-only archived, while human records may remain under docs/archive.

rejected_experiments.policy: canonical negative evidence, not active experts and not garbage

operational_state.policy: live service state, sessions and caches; outside model-evaluation claims; preserve

unknown.policy: classification unresolved at this audit; preserve. Neither historical nor deletable can be inferred solely from a name or mtime.

private_local_assets.policy: May remain on the development server; never part of the public Git release. Local presence must not be required by portable CI.

source_code.policy: Current runtime, canonical reproduction source, and extended reproduction tests are explicitly classified. Historical research source may remain tracked for lineage; lineage-only development tests are demoted from public Git with hashes recorded in historical_source_demotions.json.

legacy_compatibility.policy: Legacy Catalyst/terpene/current/V3/V4 names may remain when they are frozen component provenance or actual runtime dependencies. They never override the current BiME-Rank production/canonical authorities.
